2. If it is a vowel (a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive), map it using the reversed vowel list: 'a' <-> 'u', 'e' <-> 'o', 'i' <-> 'i'. Preserve the original case.
3. If it is a consonant (any letter that is not a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive), map it using the reversed consonant list: [b, c, d, f, g, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, q, r, s, t, v, w, x, y, z] mapped to [z, y, x, w, v, t, s, r, q, p, n, m, l, k, j, h, g, f, d, c, b].
